sources: Current development tree and 57-PDF audit
evidence_claim: Literature establishes distinctions and hazards but does not itself establish package demand or support
strategic_requirement: Freeze provenance and nonclaims before selecting work
independent_oracle: Page counts hashes and source audit are independently reproducible
negative_control: A newly added paper does not automatically reopen public scope
test_target: Audit completeness and public-boundary diff
user_decision: Whether current public scope changes
cheaper_alternative: Keep the bounded public scope

sources: Current source-coupling audit; Adams et al. 1997; Huang and Cai 2024; Hui 2019; Aliyar et al. 2026; Robles-Garcia et al. 2026; Menzel 2021
evidence_claim: Parameter design latent loading outcome random owner and dependence axes are not interchangeable dimensions; the vocabulary does not by itself justify a production registry
strategic_requirement: Park a three-spec registry until a current unenforced invariant or two admitted consumers and a concrete branch-deletion inventory exist
independent_oracle: Current semantic choke-point inventory plus named before-after branch deletions required before any shadow code
negative_control: Registry fields are added while existing bound config fixed-calibration replay and evidence authorities remain
test_target: A1 admission status production-consumer count lifecycle ownership and deletable branch inventory
user_decision: Whether a shared registry reduces current user or maintenance risk
cheaper_alternative: Retain explicit branches and invariant vocabulary; reopen only on recorded demand

sources: Current RSM PCM bounded-GPCM implementation and fixed-calibration artifacts
evidence_claim: An architectural seam is valuable only if it preserves current meaning and removes rather than duplicates branching
strategic_requirement: Require exact semantic parity and a simplification inventory only if A1 reopens
independent_oracle: Legacy direct probability objective gradient and artifact fixtures
negative_control: A tolerance is widened after observing unexplained drift
test_target: Probability objective gradient output warning scoring and artifact parity after an accepted compiler change
user_decision: Whether existing analyses remain identical after internal refactoring
cheaper_alternative: Keep the current production architecture and indexed semantic baseline

sources: Current evaluate_mfrm_design future execution contract; Pawel et al. 2026; Siepe et al. 2024; Pawel et al. 2024; White et al. 2024; Braun et al. 2014; Menzel 2021
evidence_claim: Simulation conclusions depend on truthful execution paths complete attempt denominators prespecification Monte Carlo uncertainty and code-DGM-metric checks
strategic_requirement: Use a study-level evidence identity that references existing fit or calibration identities and preserves failure without forcing A1
independent_oracle: Fixed-ordered-grid serial and future equality with ambient-RNG preservation; known-answer cells replayed with an independent metric implementation
negative_control: Successful runs are replenished to a target count or a seed metric or score map is chosen after results
test_target: Execution-path truth fixed-grid serial-future equality attempt accounting identity-derived RNG replay MCSE amendments and indeterminate decisions
user_decision: Whether a named confirmatory method claim advances narrows or stops
cheaper_alternative: Use deterministic tests and study-specific records; open the minimal ledger only for a named confirmation

sources: Fischer 1973; Fischer and Ponocny 1994; Robles-Garcia et al. 2026
evidence_claim: LLTM or LPCM constrains item parameters through a known design and does not define a response family or latent dimension
strategic_requirement: Admit only for a prespecified item-component or new-item decision
independent_oracle: Direct A or W matrix likelihood and saturated PCM or RSM reductions
negative_control: Frequency bands or post-hoc score summaries are treated as independent traits
test_target: Rank contrast row-map reduction and held-out new-item prediction
user_decision: Whether prespecified item components improve interpretation or prediction
cheaper_alternative: Use PCM plus eRm or TAM or post-fit descriptive analysis

sources: Samejima 1969; Andersson and Xin 2021; Bee and Koch 2026; bundled-data eligibility audit
evidence_claim: GRM uses cumulative boundaries while PCM and GPCM use adjacent-category geometry; ordered numeric scores and multiple observed facets do not themselves establish cumulative semantics or multidimensionality
strategic_requirement: Admit only when cumulative geometry changes a named ordinal decision in an owner-confirmed representative packet
independent_oracle: Independent Samejima cumulative-difference probabilities and derivatives plus a pre-fit packet-eligibility audit
negative_control: A polytomous GRM is made numerically identical to GPCM by relabeling steps or repeated ratings are silently averaged voted selected or converted to Rater-by-Criterion pseudo-items
test_target: Normalization threshold order binary reduction endpoints gradients proper-score comparison the external-mirt Gate 0.5 new-Person score probe and exact bundled-object intake accounting
user_decision: Whether cumulative rather than adjacent geometry changes calibration prediction or an action-linked workflow decision
cheaper_alternative: Use current adjacent families or integrate with mirt after an eligible external packet arrives

sources: Skrondal and Rabe-Hesketh 2009; Merkle et al. 2019; Stenhaug and Domingue 2022; Rabinowicz and Rosset 2022
evidence_claim: Conditional and marginal predictions answer different future-entity questions and CV must reproduce the future training relation
strategic_requirement: Make prediction target grouping and integrated effects explicit before adding LOO machinery
independent_oracle: Independently generated future samples for same-person new-person new-item new-rater and crossed targets
negative_control: Row-wise likelihood is reused for a new-entity claim
test_target: Grouped likelihood strict refit and target-signature refusal
user_decision: Which population or entity an analysis can generalize to
cheaper_alternative: Report fit diagnostics without prediction language

sources: Gneiting and Raftery 2007; Braun et al. 2014; Bee and Koch 2026
evidence_claim: Distributional comparison needs a proper score and fit-once approximations remain target-specific approximations
strategic_requirement: Keep exact refit and approximation identities separate and make ranking uncertainty visible
independent_oracle: Manual log Brier or ranked-probability scores plus explicit refits
negative_control: Accuracy alone selects a model or a ranking within MCSE is called a win
test_target: Score orientation clipping ranking MCSE and approximation error
user_decision: Whether a predictive ranking is decision-relevant and reproducible
cheaper_alternative: Use a small externally scripted cross-validation study

sources: Cameron et al. 2011; MacKinnon et al. 2021; Owen 2007; Owen and Eckles 2012; Bakshy and Eckles 2013
evidence_claim: Sampling dependence axes are distinct from model facets and multiway methods have design-specific limits
strategic_requirement: Compile a resampling plan from sampling and assignment assumptions rather than model labels
independent_oracle: Direct one-way and inclusion-exclusion covariance or product-weight calculations
negative_control: Adding a crossed random effect automatically selects multiway inference
test_target: Coverage width non-PSD few-cluster sparse-incidence and highest-order controls
user_decision: Whether uncertainty reflects the actual sampling design
cheaper_alternative: Retain person-cluster stability analysis or use design-specific external inference

sources: Menzel 2021
evidence_claim: Two-way cluster dimensions are dependence axes and no selector is uniformly valid over the full parameter space
strategic_requirement: State pointwise versus uniform scope and degeneracy behavior
independent_oracle: Nonseparable pairwise-uncorrelated array generator with known limiting behavior
negative_control: Good pointwise performance is reported as uniform validity
test_target: Local-to-zero fixed-axis and conservative-near-degeneracy cells
user_decision: Whether the uncertainty method remains useful near weak dependence
cheaper_alternative: Narrow the inference claim or report sensitivity

sources: van der Linden 2007; Hui et al. 2025; Hui 2019
evidence_claim: Time can be a separate observed outcome or latent speed process and neither automatically adds a content dimension
strategic_requirement: Require actor unit event identity and a decision beyond descriptive QC
independent_oracle: Direct one-ability one-speed lognormal likelihood and time-unit transformation
negative_control: Every ResponseTime column becomes person speed or two time outcomes become D equals two
test_target: Factorized covariance-zero unit-conversion and missingness tests
user_decision: Whether time changes measurement or prediction beyond quality review
cheaper_alternative: Keep response_time_review descriptive or use LNIRT

sources: Guo et al. 2025
evidence_claim: Omitted and not-reached responses have different event-time mechanisms including competing clocks and right censoring
strategic_requirement: Add survival semantics only after the base time and event graph are qualified
independent_oracle: Manual small risk-set and competing-event likelihood
negative_control: Omitted not-reached unpresented and structurally unreachable are one NA state
test_target: Response-only time-only NRI-only OI-only and joint reductions
user_decision: Whether nonresponse mechanisms materially change ability reporting
cheaper_alternative: Retain typed missingness descriptions without a joint survival likelihood

sources: Wilson and Hoskens 2001
evidence_claim: Rater-bundle dependence changes a joint pattern likelihood and is not an additive facet interaction
strategic_requirement: Admit only when true bundle dependence changes reliability or uncertainty
independent_oracle: Enumerated bundle-pattern probabilities
negative_control: Facet interaction is used as the dependence parameter or bundle IDs are inferred from row order
test_target: Normalization kappa-zero order connectivity and partial-bundle tests
user_decision: Whether ratings may be treated as conditionally independent
cheaper_alternative: Keep the additive model and expose a dependence limitation

sources: Huang and Cai 2024; Quene and van den Bergh 2008; Rasbash and Goldstein 1994; Raudenbush 1993; Van den Noortgate et al. 2003
evidence_claim: Crossed owners define variance ownership and generalization populations rather than content dimensionality
strategic_requirement: Require sampled-population targets typical-data information and connected incidence
independent_oracle: Small crossed Gaussian or binary likelihood with label-permutation and zero-variance reductions
negative_control: Two crossed owners are reported as a two-dimensional ability
test_target: Owner-specific recovery sparse incidence dominant owner and fixed-owner controls
user_decision: Which owner population an estimate should generalize to
cheaper_alternative: Use fixed facets or a mature crossed-GLMM implementation

sources: Tibaldi et al. 2007; Bellio et al. 2025
evidence_claim: Conditional pseudo and composite objectives are not exact full marginal likelihoods and need objective-specific uncertainty
strategic_requirement: Separate probability identity objective contribution map and proof envelope
independent_oracle: Matched-parameter full conditional pseudo and binary-probit composite microcases
negative_control: Composite contributions are sent to WAIC PSIS-LOO or a joint proper score
test_target: Attenuation inversion sandwich uncertainty imbalance link and denominator refusals
user_decision: Whether a scalable objective is valid for the actual crossed design
cheaper_alternative: Use external objective-specific software or narrow to fixed facets

sources: van der Linden and Jeon 2012; Jeon et al. 2017
evidence_claim: Initial review change and final responses form event paths with structural nonreachability
strategic_requirement: Require observed opportunities routes and a prefit leaf map before process claims
independent_oracle: Manual conditional-transition and tree path products
negative_control: Final-only rows are expanded into invented process events
test_target: Leaf normalization route invariance unknown opportunity and structural-missingness refusal
user_decision: Whether answer-change information alters an interpretation unavailable from final scores
cheaper_alternative: Analyze final responses only and state that the process is unidentified

sources: Wei et al. 2023; Bolsinova et al. 2022; Alarcon et al. 2023
evidence_claim: Mixed-format and hint states can be sequential processes or scoring models and deeper nodes have less information
strategic_requirement: Keep graph identity score-map identity and node reachability separate from ordinal family labels
independent_oracle: Enumerated leaf products and frozen alternative score maps
negative_control: A three-level path score is automatically GPCM or the best score map is called prespecified
test_target: Label route score-map hash node information and rare-hint recovery
user_decision: Whether observed paths support a distinct response mechanism
cheaper_alternative: Use a fixed scoring rule or external IRTree analysis

sources: Adams et al. 1997; Andersson and Xin 2021; Bolsinova et al. 2022
evidence_claim: True multidimensionality needs named latent axes loading design covariance and identification and may include a process axis only when separately justified
strategic_requirement: Admit MIRT only for prespecified constructs adequate indicators and useful subscores
independent_oracle: Independent low-D softmax or family probability and D-equals-one reduction
negative_control: Facet outcome method hint event or integration rank silently increments D
test_target: A-B rank SPD sign permutation rotation indicator-density and heterogeneous-generator tests
user_decision: Whether defensible stable subscores change a user decision

sources: Hui 2019; Gueorguieva 2001; Agogo et al. 2019; Broatch and Lohr 2012; Aliyar et al. 2026
evidence_claim: Multiple observed outcomes and crossed outcome covariances are not multiple person content traits
strategic_requirement: Keep outcome identity shared owners and covariance-aware contrasts explicit

negative_control: Outcome-specific IDs split one person or separate-fit score correlation becomes structural covariance
test_target: D-zero zero-cross-covariance owner permutation missing-outcome and contrast tests
user_decision: Whether joint outcome covariance changes an estimate contrast or prediction

sources: Koch et al. 2015; Jeon and Rabe-Hesketh 2012; Leckie 2018; Robles-Garcia et al. 2026
evidence_claim: Method factors structured random covariance and score correlations have distinct semantic roles
strategic_requirement: Split method and computational-factor probes and never infer structural correlation from point scores

test_target: Role scale rotation rank boundary and separate-fit negative controls

sources: Aliyar et al. 2026; Robles-Garcia et al. 2026

strategic_requirement: Preserve shared person and item identity overlapping bands and analysis objective
independent_oracle: Manual shared-row map cumulative-incidence rank correlated-correlation and nested-regression checks
negative_control: Three tests become D equals three or cumulative score bands become independent outcomes
test_target: Outcome order band overlap local dependence class assignment and score-versus-item objective controls

sources: Ulitzsch et al. 2024; Tutz and Berger 2016; Jin et al. 2022
evidence_claim: Response style process mixtures and ideal-point mechanisms require separately qualified submodels and uncertain membership
strategic_requirement: Keep mixture work off the core path and prohibit automatic deletion

negative_control: Hard class labels are treated as truth or inconvenient responses are removed automatically
test_target: Label switching prevalence collapse separation calibration and missingness tests

sources: Gilbert Kim and Miratrix 2023; Gilbert et al. 2025; Agogo et al. 2019
evidence_claim: Item and person treatment heterogeneity needs assignment timing estimand and causal assumptions beyond measurement-model fit
strategic_requirement: Keep causal work out of the measurement-family roadmap by default

negative_control: A random slope or fit improvement is named a treatment effect
